added_failures_note: Derived from the reviewed run's own suite pair: baseline_suite (8ad90651f6) failed 3 ids at the base arm and after_suite (b7bda19d37) failed none, so the reviewed pair adds no failure. The reviewer's independent arm over tests/test_lane_change_reads_the_worktree.py, a file the reviewed run did not run, is 7 passed at 8ad90651f6 and 5 failed at 30a7167c3b; see reviewer_added_failures and the blocking finding.

findings.summary: The change adds a second module-level _worktree_git_read at 2229 beside the existing one at 1471 with a different signature (str instead of (CompletedProcess, error)). Module import binds the later definition, so _inherited_worktree_reading at 1492 unpacks a str into (result, error) and raises ValueError: too many values to unpack for any worktree that exists. Measured at the reviewed head: 5 of 7 tests in tests/test_lane_change_reads_the_worktree.py fail, against 7 passed at base 8ad90651f6. Production reach is the lane-change prompt at dispatch_sessions.py:1610, re-exported by reckon/crew/dispatch.py:4007.

_preserve_stopped_worktree re-implements worktree residue capture that reckon/crew/routing.py:_save_and_release_worktree at 1452 already owns (git diff HEAD plus the tracked and untracked name lists written into the run directory) without extending, wrapping or naming that owner; the two implementations now differ silently in flags and in failure behaviour.

The section requires the saved diff's path in both the result crew stop prints and the attempt's exit record. The landed change carries it on the run's record and its detail only; the exit record is composed by reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:_supervisor_exit_record at 3001, which is outside this node's write fence and is declared under outside_scope rather than delivered, so that half of the deliverable still needs a node that owns that module.

FINDING reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:2249 non-blocking: _preserve_stopped_worktree re-implements the residue capture that reckon/crew/routing.py:_save_and_release_worktree at 1452 owns, without extending or wrapping it.
